claims.evidence: Witness only reports a blue plastic lidded drum; no readable markings/certification or interior/label photos are shown.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Witness notes scuffs/stains from use but does not show any proof of prior use or cleaning history.
Photos show external wear but do not include a leak test, gasket condition close-up, or water-tight verification.
Lid latches/straps and a small round cap/vent are visible, but the witness does not confirm all accessories (e.g., spare caps/taps/fittings) or gasket integrity.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume unknown, which affects value and suitability for the buyer’s use
risks.proof: A clear photo of the drum’s capacity marking (litres) or a measurement fill-line/scale shot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unspecified used plastic storage drum (worst-case: smaller/unknown capacity).

risks.risk: Food-grade claim may be false; drum may have been used for non-food chemicals or not properly cleaned
risks.proof: Close-up photos of any brand/grade markings or certification on the drum, plus an interior photo showing cleanliness/residue.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a general used plastic drum (not guaranteed food-grade).

risks.risk: Leak-proof status not verified; gasket/seal may be worn or the vent/cap may not seal
risks.proof: A short clip of a water-fill test (fill to near top, show no drips over a few minutes) and a close-up of the lid gasket/seal area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed leak-proof (worst-case: may leak).

risks.risk: Hidden cracks/pinholes or structural damage not visible from the outside
risks.proof: A full 360° inspection video/clip in good light, including underside and any seams/handles, plus a tap/press test clip.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged beyond surface wear (worst-case: may have hidden defects).

risks.risk: Interior contamination/residue could remain even if exterior looks okay
risks.proof: Interior photo(s) showing bottom and walls, ideally with a quick wipe/clean cloth test result.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring cleaning/unknown interior condition.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (spare caps, taps, fittings), reducing usability
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (caps, taps, fittings) and a shot showing the lid/vent/cap assembly fully.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drum only (no guaranteed accessories).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo showing any markings/labels (brand, grade, capacity in litres, serial numbers).
Send interior photos (bottom and walls) showing cleanliness/residue.
Send a close-up of the lid gasket/seal and the vent/cap assembly.
Send a short water-fill leak test clip (fill, show no drips for a few minutes).
Confirm what accessories are included (spare caps, taps, fittings) with photos of the full set.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a used blue plastic lidded storage drum, but key value drivers (capacity, food-grade proof, leak-proof verification, interior condition) are not shown. Price it at the worst case for a used, unverified food-grade and leak-proof status until proof is provided.
